## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.5`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noVueDeprecatedFunctionalTemplate`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`vue/no-deprecated-functional-template`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/no-deprecated-functional-template)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueDeprecatedFunctionalTemplate": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow the deprecated `functional` attribute on the `<template>` of a Vue component.

Vue 2 let you write `<template functional>` to turn a component into a
functional component (a component without its own state). Vue 3 no
longer supports this attribute, because functional components are no
faster than regular components anymore. Remove the attribute and use a
regular `<template>` instead.

See the [Vue 3 migration guide](https://v3-migration.vuejs.org/breaking-changes/functional-components.html) for more information.

## Examples

### Invalid

```vue
<template functional>
  <div>{{ props.message }}</div>
</template>
```

```vue
</template>
```
